raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (2026-01-18 ingest, 350 rows, all of them 'USD_CENTS') stores amounts in cents, but silver_transactions ignores amount_unit and treats them as dollars, inflating the 2026-01-17 totals about 100x. Dividing USD_CENTS amounts by 100 in silver_transactions corrects the amounts, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.82, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CASE WHEN amount_unit = 'USD_CENTS' THEN CAST(amount / 100.0 AS DECIMAL(12,2)) ELSE CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) END AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
